name: chikn-game-assets
description: Publicly hosted Chikn, Roostr, and FarmLand community asset source and runtime distributions.

scripts.build: npm run assets:build && npm run build -w @chikn-game-assets/runtime
scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run rights:validate && npm run content-terms:validate && npm run verify && npm run distribution:report && node scripts/verify-source-layout.mjs && node scripts/verify-public-tree.mjs && node scripts/verify-lifecycle.mjs
scripts.builder:dev: npm run showcase:data && npm run dev -w chikn-game-assets-showcase -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173
scripts.showcase:build: npm run showcase:data && npm run build -w chikn-game-assets-showcase
scripts.pages:build: npm run build && npm run showcase:build && npm run docs:build && node scripts/assemble-pages.mjs
scripts.release:assemble: npm run build && npm run release:sources:stage && node scripts/assemble-release.mjs
scripts.release:verify: npm ci && npm run build && npm run api:verify && npm test && npm run check && npm run pack:check && npm run release:sources:stage
